en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a large, old building partially obscured by tall trees. The building has multiple windows arranged symmetrically and a prominent entrance. The setting appears to be peaceful, with a grassy area and some fencing in front. The text at the bottom identifies the location and building, and there is a stamp indicating the photographer or publisher in the lower right corner.
